title: Cabinet Approves ₹23,731 Crore GOBARdhan Bioenergy Scheme (FY27 to FY36)
summary: Accelerates organic waste conversion into compressed biogas (CBG) under National Circular Bioenergy Scheme.

blocks.content: Accelerates organic waste conversion into compressed biogas (CBG) under National Circular Bioenergy Scheme.

items: Scheme Name: Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan (GOBARdhan).
Total Financial Outlay: ₹23,731 crore for 10-year implementation (FY 2026-27 to FY 2035-36).
